modules.name: OTIS Sampler
modules.description: CV sampler with MAME-derived ES5505 playback arithmetic. Prototype; no Ensoniq firmware required.

modules.name: Otis Kit
modules.description: A bank of eight sample slots on OTIS's ES5505 playback arithmetic: per-slot tune, decay, level, filter, start and direction, slot chosen per hit by a bus word or the gate channel.

modules.name: Otis Capture
modules.description: Records takes of a set number of beats, from an input or the kit's own output, into a slot of the Otis Kit on its left; a new take replaces the slot only when complete.
